svg.text: The life of a MARVIN ticket — start to finish, with every loop back
Works, but needs you or is fragile
You notice something, a digest or sweep
suggests it, or a session finds a bug
A GitHub issue with acceptance criteria,
a project: label and 'Blocked by' links
needs-info — decided by the triage agent
picks the top unclaimed, unblocked ticket
the project's own tests and checks
evidence in the PR body: metrics,
one card per PR: one headline,
only the buttons that make sense
the one human step on the main path
behind main AND shares files? rebase + retest;
stacked PRs move onto main, other PRs get a
conflict check, the app rebuilds, main-health runs
a purpose metric is checked after a date
the agent fixes and re-runs; after the
the reason goes back to the ticket;
a claim that outlives its run blocks
every PR waits for you, even
↩ missed? it becomes a new ticket
